stem_book: [Passage] The state of a mole of an ideal gas changed from state A at pressure 2P and volume V follows four different processes and finally returns to initial state A reversibly, as shown in the P–V graph: A(V, 2P) → B(2V, 2P) → C(2V, P) → D(V, P) → A(V, 2P). What would be the total work done by the gas, expressed as w with the IUPAC sign convention (w = −∫P dV)? (a) −PV (b) PV (c) 0 (d) None of these
reason: missing from manifest; printed key a uses the book's sign convention (cf. Level-4 Q7 'work done by the gas: w = −11.488 kJ'); the magnitude of work done by the gas is +PV, so the IUPAC-convention clause was added to make (a) unambiguous
